documents.title: Discount policy
documents.content:
1. Repeat customers receive a 5 percent discount on standard items.
2. New customers do not receive a discount.
3. The maximum approved discount is 10 percent and requires admin approval.

documents.title: Returns policy
documents.content:
1. Opened items may be returned within 14 days with the original receipt.
2. Sealed items may be returned within 30 days.
3. Refunds are sent to the original payment method.

documents.title: Credit terms
documents.content:
1. Approved business customers have net 30 payment terms.
2. New customers must pay at the time of purchase.
3. Credit above 5000 requires admin approval.
